MPSC Chairman Steps Aside, Panel Head Appointed, Ending Pune Protest

Amid a paper‑leak controversy at the Maharashtra Public Service Commission, aspirants in Pune staged a protest that lasted about ten to eleven days; after a midnight agreement the MPSC chairman went on leave and stepped aside, and Tukaram Mundhe was appointed secretary of the panel set up to probe the leaks, which led to the protest ending.
